[size=2]This portrait redraw (currently a WIP) changes the cartoon-y style of the original Stardew Valley portraits, while maintaining their sometimes silly expressions and the overall game aesthetic. They fit in seamlessly with only a few major changes to expressions listed below.[/size]
[size=3][b]
[/b][b]Installation

[/b][/size]Download the .xnb files, then navigate to your Stardew Valley folder. Go to Content->Portraits, back up the .xnb files for the characters you are replacing, then drag and drop the downloaded files and confirm to replace.

[b][size=3]Currently Finished[/size]

[/b]Elliot: no major modifications to any expressions, besides making him front-facing
Shane: "passed out drunk" expression changed to "bleary, drunk, and dishevelled", in the interest of consistency and keeping him facing the player
Alex: "eating" expression modified slightly to be tidier because Evelyn didn't raise him to chew with his mouth open on a date
Harvey: no major modifications to any expressions, besides alternate "no moustache" version

[size=3][b]In Progress
[/b][/size]
